metadata.title: मुख्यमंत्री आदिवासी नहीं होता है - बाबूलाल मरांडी | JMM using Adivasi Card - BJP | Jharkhand Update
metadata.description:
Champai Soren of the Jharkhand Mukti Morcha took oath as the twelfth chief minister of Jharkhand on February 2, 2024. Following the ceremony, 39 MLAs from the ruling coalition, accommodated in the Ranchi circuit house, were abruptly moved to the airport and flown to Hyderabad. We asked Babhulal Marandi, BJP president and former CM of Jharkhand about the perceived fear of the BJP attempting to poach MLAs in various states to destabilise governments. The question implies a concern about BJP's reputation for allegedly engaging in political manoeuvres to bring down ruling coalitions in different states.
